headline: MARA sells 13,597 bitcoin to clear its loans

scenes.vo: One of the biggest public bitcoin holders just sold more than thirteen thousand coins. Here's what changed.
In a filing with the SEC, MARA says it sold thirteen thousand five hundred ninety seven bitcoin after the quarter ended, for about one point one billion dollars.

Here's why traders are watching it. MARA used seven hundred fifty million dollars to fully pay off its bitcoin backed loans, and it booked about six hundred thirty two million dollars in quarterly profit.
The catch? MARA held about thirty four thousand bitcoin at the end of September, so this sale is roughly forty percent of that stack, as it shifts toward artificial intelligence.
Here's what happens next. Watch whether other miners and bitcoin treasury companies sell coins to cut debt.
